# Botvio

> Botvio delivers AI-powered forex signals, gold (XAU/USD) trading analysis, automated trading bots, and mentorship for traders using Deriv, Exness, Weltrade, Pocket Option, and Binance.

Botvio combines live market signals, chart analysis, copy trading, and educational content to help retail traders across Africa and worldwide trade forex, crypto, synthetic indices, and binary options responsibly.
